gaps.sentence: ___ complaining about the problem, why not suggest a solution?
gaps.explanation: 'Instead of + -ing' contrasts one behaviour with a preferable alternative.

gaps.sentence: She took a map ___ she wouldn't get lost.
I'll take the job ___ they don't offer me any more money.
gaps.explanation: 'Even if' concedes a future possibility that will not change the decision.

gaps.sentence: British houses usually have gardens, ___ flats in Spain often have balconies.
___ feeling nervous, she delivered a flawless presentation.
gaps.explanation: 'In spite of' + -ing expresses concession with a non-finite form.

gaps.sentence: ___ had I closed my eyes than the alarm went off.
gaps.explanation: The 'than' in the sentence forces 'No sooner', the only linker paired with than.

gaps.sentence: The treatment doesn't weaken patients; ___, it speeds up their recovery.
gaps.explanation: 'On the contrary' asserts the opposite of what was just said.

gaps.sentence: ___ the strike, trains will run a reduced service all week.
gaps.explanation: 'Because of the strike' gives the reason for the reduced service.
